welcome.en: Our favourite people, all in one place. Join us for a day of good food, happy tears, and a very full dance floor.
welcome.zh-Hans: 期待与最亲爱的你们欢聚一堂，一起分享美食、感动与舞池里的快乐。

story.en: A chance meeting, a long conversation, and a thousand little adventures later—here we are. We cannot wait to start this next chapter with you beside us.
story.zh-Hans: 一次偶遇，一场长谈，和无数小小的冒险，让我们走到了今天。期待与你们一起开启人生的新篇章。

directions.en: This is a fictional venue. Replace these details with your own directions and an accessible entrance description.
directions.zh-Hans: 这是示例场地。请填写实际地址、交通方式和无障碍入口说明。

description.en: Arrive from 2:30 pm, find a seat, and settle in. The ceremony begins at 3 pm.
description.zh-Hans: 请于下午2:30开始入场，仪式于下午3:00开始。

description.en: A shared feast, a few speeches, and dancing until late. Last shuttle departs at 11:30 pm.
description.zh-Hans: 享受晚宴、祝福致辞和舞会。末班接驳车于晚上11:30出发。

text.en: Add train stations, driving directions, parking, and shuttle times here. Include a plain address that guests can copy into their preferred map app.
text.zh-Hans: 请填写火车站、驾车路线、停车和接驳时间，并提供可复制到地图应用的地址。

text.en: Add hotel recommendations, room-block booking links, prices, and booking deadlines. These examples are editable from the admin dashboard.
text.zh-Hans: 请添加酒店推荐、预订链接、价格和截止日期。这些示例可在管理后台编辑。

answer.en: Garden-party formal. Wear something you love, with shoes comfortable enough for grass and dancing. Replace this with your dress code.
answer.zh-Hans: 花园派对正装。请穿着喜欢的服装，以及适合草地和跳舞的舒适鞋子。请替换为你的着装要求。

answer.en: Please tell us about allergies and dietary requirements in your RSVP. We will confirm arrangements with the caterer.
answer.zh-Hans: 请在回复中填写过敏和饮食需求，我们会与餐饮团队确认安排。

question.en: Can I bring children or a plus-one?
question.zh-Hans: 可以携带儿童或伴侣吗？

answer.en: Your invitation lists everyone in your party. Contact the coordinator if you need to discuss an adjustment.
answer.zh-Hans: 你的请柬会列出受邀成员。如需调整，请联系协调人。

answer.en: We will move the ceremony indoors. Any changes will appear on this website and be emailed to affected guests.
answer.zh-Hans: 仪式将移至室内。任何调整都会发布在网站上，并通过邮件通知相关宾客。

answer.en: Replace this with verified step-free access, accessible toilets, and quiet-space details. You can share access requirements privately in your RSVP.
answer.zh-Hans: 请填写经确认的无台阶通道、无障碍卫生间和安静区域信息。你可以在回复中私下告知无障碍需求。

description.en: Your presence is the gift. If you would like, help us make a memory on our honeymoon. Replace this example link with your fund provider.
description.zh-Hans: 你的到来就是最好的礼物。如愿意，也可为我们的蜜月添一份美好回忆。请替换为实际基金链接。

description.en: An example universal gift item. Guests can reserve an item before visiting the shop; purchases are confirmed by the guest.
description.zh-Hans: 这是通用礼物清单示例。宾客可以先预留，再前往商店购买；购买完成后由宾客确认。
